summary: #edu407 you will find many students do not like the tyranny of the blank page. Sometimes, all the time, constraint can help creativity. When ever you do provide free writes offer suggested topics. In younger grades display sentence starters. In older grades provide models of different elements like hooks.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#edu407 you will find many students do not like the tyranny of the blank page. Sometimes, all the time, constraint can help creativity. When ever you do provide free writes offer suggested topics.
In younger grades display sentence starters.
In older grades provide models of different elements like hooks.
